reviews.title: Hardly ever works!
reviews.text: I have had this camera for five years now and it has never worked well for me. It works just fine on my husband's android, but it takes forever to load on my iPhone. Half the time it will not even load! It is so so frustrating, I don't know why we got it.

reviews.title: Not worth the hassle
reviews.text:
The number of times this camera disconnects and either the app or the camera its self needs to be reset would be comical if it wasn’t so infuriating. 
Camera wouldn’t connect for days, so I finally went ahead and tried resetting it, now I can’t set it up again, it won’t complete the pairing process. 

Great when it works, but not worth the trouble.

reviews.title: Sock User - MORE WIDGETS
reviews.text:
My husband and I love this sock!  After spending some time with the NICU, this purchase was non-negotiable. 

I wish there were more visuals, I wish I was able to lock my phone and still see the BPM’s or oxygen level levels or on the widget app on my home screen still see the same information. I don’t wanna add or edit nap sessions.

I have a separate monitor propped up every night and then I have my phone set up right next to it with the owlet app open and after a certain amount of time when my phone goes dark I can no longer see his BPM‘s or oxygen levels. But I can still hear him on the monitor. I would love something on the lock screen, more options on the Home Screen/night mode widgets ❤️ visuals are everything

reviews.title: Amazing purchase
reviews.text: I love this sock, it helps ease my crazy mind and thinking something will happen while i’m asleep. I’ve only had 1 false alarm, it definitely scared me but knowing that it works makes me feel better. I only wish that I could rock my baby to sleep without the alarm going off that it can’t get a reading. And the camera, i wish it wasn’t so delayed so i know what’s happening at that moment. Other than that it’s amazing and would definitely recommend to family and friends.

reviews.title: Saved our son’s life
reviews.text: Our owlet monitor warned us when our son stopped breathing and allowed us to act quickly preventing any possibility of SIDS.

reviews.title: Good but needs multiple bug fixes
reviews.text:
We have been using this app since our daughter was born in May. For the most part it works as it should but we have noticed a few irritating bugs. 
1. When you receive a notification for sound/motion detection, once that is clicked on and the Owlet app opens back up, the camera feed will not display. The red light on the camera turns on as if it is actively recording but in the app, the loading circle just spins forever. Both my husband and I have to close out the app and open it back up for the camera feed to display. This is quite annoying to do because I should be able to click on the motion detection notification and it show the camera feed 
2. If you are viewing the live camera footage while wearing headphones/airpods and click on the mic to turn it on and talk, it automatically shuts off the sound on the app while you’re talking. Totally fine except when you turn the mic off and the sound back on, it plays through the phone speakers not your headphones/airpods.

reviews.title: Great when it works
reviews.text: It’s great when the app actually works but recently the connection has been horrible and nothing I do fixes it. After the last update my camera hasn’t loaded once. Very frustrating

reviews.title: Never stays connected
reviews.text: It will not connect to the WiFi. If it does-it drops right away. The WiFi is not the issue. I’ve got the requirements they ask for and still nothing. The app worked great for the few days it did and gave peace of mind- now it just gives me anxiety and I’m up checking on my baby more. Support has been of no help!!!!

reviews.title: Needs fixing
reviews.text: Video keeps freezing after recent update. For example baby is shown sleeping but in reality baby was awake and standing please fix.

reviews.title: Sock constantly disconnects from base station
reviews.text: This is the ONLY device in my whole house that I have to reconnect to WiFi every single night. My baby has other devices - WiFi sound machine, other brand WiFi baby monitor, all stay connected to WiFi. I checked online & it seems this is a problem many parents have with Owlet. My negative review is for the app itself. Even after I go thru the steps to reconnect it, if I close the app and reopen it 10 mins later to check baby’s stats, it will say disconnected from base station again. It has to be an issue with the software in this app. We have a smart home and have never had issues like this.

reviews.title: Takes forever to load
reviews.text: Sometimes it doesn’t load at all. Especially when your baby is coughing or crying or something, it won’t load for that. It likes to not work at the most inconvenient times. Also won’t cover their warranty when they say they will !

reviews.title: Great in theory
reviews.text: The owlet sock is great, and offers a lot of peace of mind. And the camera and sensors are great, when they work. The app often takes a long time to load the camera, if it loads at all. When it works it’s great, and very helpful, but sometimes requires patience.

reviews.title: Slow - works 1/2 the time
reviews.text: Sometimes the app works fine. Sometimes the app will just spin and spin and nothing works. I will not be purchasing another owlet due to the app.

reviews.title: Camera intermittent since last update
reviews.text: Only one stream allowed at a time since last update which makes it impossible for both parents to check on the app simultaneously. Now it doesn’t work for either of us. Owlet needs to fix ASAP. Spent too much on this POS for it to not work.

reviews.title: App slow to load video
reviews.text:
We’ve had the owlet for 3 years now. The most frustrating part is how slow to load the video it is. Sometimes it doesn’t even load and I need to restart the app. 

Also, the status light goes on the camera from time to time when it is not turned on in the app for either parent.

reviews.title: Never works
reviews.text: At least they added words like “almost ready” when the camera never works and it’s just a spinning circle

reviews.title: Terrible Experience
reviews.text:
Edit 10/3: the app has now become entirely unusable for me. There is no issue with the camera since my husband’s android app manages to successfully load the feed without issue. However, the iOS app gets continuously stuck on the “Almost ready” loader without ever successfully loading. 

I have deep regret about choosing the Owlet. The app has been extremely unreliable for me. Specifically, the camera routinely fails to connect and can easily disconnect. When I try to minimize the video so I can have my baby’s feed up when navigating to another app, the feed routinely disconnects and, even when it doesn’t, there’s a massive button right over the center of the video that prevents me from actually seeing my baby. Additionally, I like to have the sound on, but it turns off the second I minimize it to navigate to another app and, even when I return back to the app, the sound won’t turn on again until after I have closed the app and reopened it again. 

I will not be using this again for baby number two.

reviews.title: Good when it works

reviews.title: Buggy

reviews.title: Lagging

reviews.title: Bug or feature??
reviews.text: Got the new update in late September (like a week ago), then my husband just got the update today. And now only one of us can see the footage from the owlet camera whereas before the update we could both view it simultaneously. I’m not sure if this has anything to do with the new “encrypting your feed” message, but I’m hoping the connection can still be encrypted while also allowing both parents to view the footage at the same time. Otherwise, having the owlet camera will be rendered useless at least 50% of the time because of how we use it as a remote baby monitor while I’m at work and my husband or another caregiver is at home with the child. Please tell me this is a bug and not how it is designed to be from now on. Or at least that there is a setting we can change to allow more than one app user to view the footage simultaneously. Please.

reviews.title: App is Horrible
reviews.text: App takes forever to load camera and sock readings, even when the app remains open in the background. The picture-in-picture mode doesn’t work for the camera either. Also there is no way to turn up the volume of the cry notifications, so forget using the camera as a baby monitor when you’re sleeping. The notification tone is so quiet it won’t wake you—you might as well just be being notified you’re getting a leisurely text, not that your baby is crying in the other room.

reviews.title: Connectivity Issues
reviews.text: The app helps give us peace of mind but it would be a lot nicer to not have to constantly close and reopen the app in the hopes it will regain connectivity (this doesn’t always fix it, either). The troubleshooting tips from the app aren’t helpful. We’ve tried all of them and it doesn’t fix the issue. I’m not sure if it’s just an Apple thing or an Owlet thing but hopefully the powers that be will figure out this bug soon. The last bug they fixed earlier this week just made my screen glitch out whenever I try to look at my baby’s sleep record. Also why is the actual sock SO difficult to turn off for a cleaning?? A simple on/off toggle would have been nice but nope we have to basically solve a puzzle and go through all the alarm bells and their colors to get it to turn off (it takes about 15-20 minutes of attempts). Their demonstration on their official TikTok account isn’t accurate either, we’ve never been able to get the base to work that way.

I genuinely felt my anxiety drift away the 2nd night of my little one’s life. The first night in the hospital I didn’t sleep at all. 3hours at most! But last night, I literally felt my anxiety disappear once I understood how to put the sock on and was able to see her stats 😫🤍

reviews.title: Turns off

reviews.title: FIX THE APP

It’s when those alerts go off and if you aren’t in quick reach of the base, forget about being able to turn it off with your phone before it wakes the baby. The live stats give you peace of mind. The entire one percent of the time that they actually load. And don’t worry, even in an emergency when there’s a critical alert, you won’t know exactly WHAT is wrong until the app FINALLY loads up. Because in an emergency we definitely have time to stare at a blank app screen while it loads. The sock is THREE HUNDRED dollars. Fix the damn app!! PLEASE

reviews.title: I hate this stupid camera
reviews.text: I have owned two over the last 7 years — one for each child. With our first, we purchased the sock, but you’d need to have been there to understand the chokehold that sock had on first time mothers in 2019. But the camera… Ohhh, the camera. I hate that thing. We stopped using the one in our son’s room quite young because he was a terrible solo sleeper and my husband or I would end up falling asleep like folded up pretzel people trying to lull, coax, bewitch, or otherwise beg him to sleep. My daughter, however, is the champion sleeper between the two. She is now four, and maybe you’re thinking “she’s four, it’s time to retire the baby cam.” Except we can’t hear her from our downstairs without one, so after we’ve tucked them in and go downstairs to prepare lunches/wash dishes/exist as adults for two hours a day, we basically lose all contact until we go to bed across the hall from her. I made the mistake of opting for a second camera when I got pregnant with her rather than getting an entirely new system for two kids. Big mistake. HUGE. I have cursed this stupid camera nearly every day of her existence. It REGULARLY has connectivity issues that are zero percent due to anything we are doing. The stupid thing is connected to the wall; it doesn’t move and it isn’t touched. Sometimes it works, most times it doesn’t, and you are wholly at the mercy of Owlet every night in hopes of actually what you bought the thing for. I purchased this device over others originally because of the ability to use it from anywhere. My husband and I have largely had no village because we have moved away from our respective homes/families and have moved to two different states since having kids. Anyone with a lack of village can tell you that there’s an immense amount of needing to know all the things, all the time, and in the most convenient ways possible. I thought that would be the Owlet, and I rue the day I ever put this stupid thing on my Babylist registry. I went to do our regular shopping today and genuinely stopped in the store to stare at baby monitors seven years into this gig. Hate, hate, hate. Double hate. Loathe entirely.

reviews.title: Night Sleep Display Is Misleading
reviews.text:
The recent sleep-tracking update has made the Owlet Dream app significantly worse.

The app now combines all overnight sleep into one “Night Sleep” period, which can be very misleading when sleep crosses midnight and includes wake periods.

For example, if my baby sleeps 7:35 PM–11:31 PM, 12:17 AM–2:44 AM, and 3:20 AM–7:17 AM, his actual sleep after midnight is 6h 24m. However, the app displays “Night Sleep, 7:35 PM–7:17 AM, 10h 18m.”

This makes it look like he slept continuously for 10h 18m, when he was actually awake for significant periods. The previous version showed each individual sleep session, making it easy to understand the data and calculate sleep after midnight.

Please allow users to tap the new sleep bar to see the individual sleep sessions and wake periods. The underlying data may be accurate, but the current presentation is confusing and misleading.

Please bring back the detailed sleep-session breakdown. This update is a step backward.

reviews.title: Mediocre connection these days
reviews.text: This app used to be fine but now it never stays connected. Every time I’m not home it always says my monitor camera is offline and won’t connect. Also it’s supposed to connect up to 5 devices and from the day we got it never connected more than just my phone. When my partner would connect his it would kick me off and if I wanted to be connected I would have to go through the whole connection process all over. I updated the app and unplugged and restarted the monitor recently which seemed to fix the issue I had with the app saying the camera was offline for almost two weeks straight. But now that I’m at work. Again it says the camera is offline. I am however still receiving notifications of noise and movements. So idk how owlet can fix their app and their connection issues but it would be great to not have to jump ship and throw the monitor out.

reviews.title: Peace
reviews.text: Peace of mind! So grateful to have this!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: New parents must have!

reviews.title: doesn’t work
reviews.text: I have had registration failed x5. I finally got it to say registration complete and then it keeps glitching when it tries to do updates/reboot. I do not have a tab to see my camera. I have turned it off, reset it, re-paired it and still not camera on my app. I cannot find anyone to help me and I am very frustrated with how expensive this is. Do not recommend

reviews.title: This app sucks - constantly goes out of connection at least once a day
reviews.text: This camera disconnects from wifi at least once daily making it impossible to check on the baby through the camera, will not be recommending any of their products to friends. I will actually be telling people to avoid all owlet products with the amount of headaches this has created. Went to a traditional Bluetooth camera and guess what 0 issues. Big waste of $

reviews.title: Owlet socks are the worst
reviews.text:
I hate owlet socks 

I’ve cursed them almost daily for 6 months 
If my wife didn’t think they helped her relax 
I would’ve thrown them out months ago

Worse part is we had twins born early so we have spend 600$ of this terrible product

1. Zero range 

2. Holding your carrying baby will make the sock disconnect 

3. No way to easily mute alarms 
If you have to take the baby in the other room

reviews.title: Anxiety Relief for first time mom
reviews.text: Definitely a splurge but for a new mom, who sometimes co-sleeps depending on how the night is going, the relief it gives me to know I’ll be notified was worth the money.

reviews.title: Connectivity- bug
reviews.text:
I do like the owlet camera when it works. But the constant loading and having to close and reopen the app is exhausting. Some nights the background audio would stop and there would be clips of my baby crying that I never heard. I would set my alarm for every 2 hours to make sure I didn’t miss anything . That was getting exhausting. I would highly recommend getting an audio monitor backup. 

The reason I didn’t replace the camera entirely is because worried about having same issues with another camera . And I do like AI detection system when it works

reviews.title: Font issue
reviews.text: New version has issue with BPM font.

reviews.title: Great for peace of mind with sock, horrific loading/quality of video
reviews.text: Sock is breath for peace of mind but has occasional connection issues if it randomly deems too far. Get the sock but get a different monitor because the video quality is bad.

reviews.title: Needs to fix their cameras!
reviews.text: The sock and alarm part is fine, but their cameras are so inconsistent and irritating! They constantly freeze and lag or most likely just won’t load at all! Even after doing all the “tips and tricks” to make them load and work again it’s still just a buffer screen. We will be switching to a different baby monitor and will probably not use owlet in the future and will tell others it’s not worth it. I’ve tried to get in contact with their costumer support and just get met with an ai chat bot which I personally won’t interact with.

reviews.title: SO MANY ISSUES
reviews.text: The sock apparently had a malfunction two weeks after my baby was born and continuously beeped at 3AM saying his oxygen was low. I rushed him to the ER for the doctor to tell me it was a fluke and he is perfectly fine. Then the camera always goes offline, to the point I have to set up another different brand camera to make sure I can see my baby when I leave the room. (My husband watches the owlet camera while he’s at work or I would get rid of it completely.) Also, now that the baby has gotten a little bigger, the sock will beep every time he starts throwing a little fit. Very obnoxious during an already overstimulating situation. He still wears the sock because when it is functioning right, it’s great. But the camera really sucks.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: This product has changed my life! Thank you Owlet!

reviews.title: Camera was just hacked.
reviews.text: I LOVE the sock. It gives me so much peace of mind. It’s the only reason I sleep at night. Well tonight, I am sleeping with the camera on my phone as a baby monitor as I do every night, I woke up to a noise coming through the camera and assumed my son had dropped his only and probably just needed it back. I walked up to the door of his bedroom when I heard an unfamiliar female voice speaking to him. This was the scariest thing ever. I immediately ran in there, unplugged it, and now I have a non WiFi camera on the way. I wish there were more security features to prevent something this dangerous from happening.

reviews.title: Good sock, bad video monitor, buggy app
reviews.text: The Owlet video monitor is incredibly buggy. Good when it works but constantly loses sound and video. Sometimes shows me still old images instead of a live camera. I have to close and reopen the app constantly to get video and audio. The sock is great but the camera is buggy and unreliable.

reviews.title: Driving me insane
reviews.text: Loses connection every five minutes and never stops beeping. On top of that the sock started giving my baby blisters every single time we used it. Horrible app and not worth your money.

reviews.title: I wish i liked this app better
reviews.text: I really like the quality of the camera but I am repeatedly annoyed at how the app loses contact. Over and over again. I have WiFi and it works well and yet the app cuts out. And has trouble reloading. It’s very annoying

reviews.title: So many bugs
reviews.text: Camera does not load consistently. Buffers constantly

reviews.title: Dream Duo
reviews.text: The camera and sock give me such peace of mind when my baby I sleeping! Being able to have it all right here on my phone is very helpful for getting stuff done while she naps or easy access when I am also trying to sleep! I do have to fix the sock placement often but it’s worth it!

reviews.title: App is awful sock is great
reviews.text: A rock could have developed a better app. Glitchy. Doesn’t always show accurate readings or wake ups. For the price of the sock and camera app should be better.

reviews.title: Inconsistent and unreliable
reviews.text: The sock frequently alarms for inaccurate readings, frequently reads as my child is sleeping while she is up and moving, and frequently disconnects from WiFi with little to no ability to reconnect on multiple different networks. When the app gives you an option to submit feedback, it conveniently is unable to submit my poor rating. I felt strongly enough about it to come to the App Store to review. For a piece of equipment that is this expensive, I’m frequently frustrated and disappointed.

reviews.title: Never truly works when I need it to
reviews.text: Picture this, as soon as you get baby down, after multiple tries, then, you open the owlet app. It reads "Owlet Cam Offline". Then it tells you to reset the camera, which requires you to reach over baby for 4 loud, annoying beeps. You attempt to restart wifi. No dice. You got to "customer care" which are just long articles, diverting you from speaking to any real human being. Do I reset the camera? Not successfully. I don't want to wake baby, and I end up needing to spend nap time in the nursery just clicking through support articles and figuring out what I need to do. Then, baby wakes up, and I don't have any more time to deal with it. I'm writing this review because this has happened to me 7/10 times, and its been irritating enough to make me regret putting this Big Brother device in my baby's nursery. This exhausted mom at nap time gives this experience a true 0/5 stars.

reviews.title: Always have had issues connecting to camera
reviews.text: Have had this for a year. Always having to reset the app multiple times just to view the camera. Extremely annoying. Fix your app to actually work please.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text:
was good at first now it goes off and says not connected to base station, turns on when its in base station, wakes baby up cuz it thinks it’s disconnected from her foot when it’s properly secured like jesus christ all these updates and still the same issues.I’ll be switching to something else soon enough that doesn’t scream every time it’s not
on the base.

reviews.title: Owlet dream sock app
reviews.text: This app is easy to use, informative, and makes it simple to keep track of everything. Knowing I can check in and see how things are going helps me relax and sleep easier. It’s been such a great addition to our nighttime routine, and I definitely recommend it to other parents looking for a little extra reassurance!

reviews.title: Life saver!
reviews.text: I couldn’t sleep without it! It’s a peace of mind. I would highly recommend to all parents!

reviews.title: Camera keeps disconnecting
reviews.text: The camera feature keeps spinning and doesn’t load video this happens way too often frequently for it to be an effective monitor

reviews.title: Features
reviews.text: For the price of the owlet dream. More features need to be available Temperature, blood pressure. I do like it for the safety of my daughter.

reviews.title: Great concept, awful execution
reviews.text:
You can’t export any sleep logs. After the recent update I have been getting a sock placement issue every hour, which wakes me and my newborn up. 

Fix your software or atleast check it before pushing an update. 

If there was another product you can guarantee I will leave this product as soon as possible.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: I have had nothing but issues with the connection side of owlet. I had one of the older versions for my older daughter and was constantly losing connection on both the camera and sock (and I don’t have WiFi or Bluetooth connection issues with anything else in my house or on my phone). Then of course they made it so the older version wasn’t usable anymore. I have them another chance and bought the new dream sock for my younger daughter and can’t even get the thing setup. I’ll be returning and they’ve lost my business for good.

reviews.title: False readings expensive subscription
reviews.text: The readings randomly drop to dangerous levels without warning giving parents a huge scare

reviews.title: Lock screen live activities would go a long way
reviews.text:
Enable live activities for sleep sessions so you can see vitals on your lock screen. Would be a game changer for sleep deprived parents trying to unlock their phones and find the app to check on vitals in the night. 

Amazing product all around though that has provided so much peace of mind with both of my boys. A must for any SIDS concerned parent, which should be everyone.

reviews.title: Camera always disconnect
reviews.text: I am about to throw this camera in the trash! It seems like every other week the camera disconnects. We use other cameras for our pets and never have issues. We have read the horrible reviews  about customer service and will be avoiding anything to do with them. I encourage everyone to buy an inside ring camera over this pile of junk. The sock is also the worst product ever! Connection gets messed up on that as well. This company takes advantage of new parents and takes their money for a horrible product. They should be banned from selling this product.

reviews.title: Months of frustration
reviews.text: Got a camera... App can't correctly send the message to the camera to toggle notifications on. Weeks of owlet support emails and trying things and they send a new camera. Was going to make a new owlet account to remove any chance of contamination and give us the best shot at success and now the app can't be logged out of. Its impossible. Even deleting the app doesn't work.

reviews.title: Alerts on trends
reviews.text: Example: higher heart rate over night on an overview or something like that

reviews.title: Hardly functional, horrible UX.
reviews.text: This app is extremely frustrating. I can walk up 3 flights of stairs and check on my baby before the app loads. Video constantly glitches and freezes. If you want something that actually works I do not recommend this app.

reviews.title: Constantly disconnecting with internet functioning properly.
reviews.text: I have high speed internet that has no issues with any other device. The owlet cameras are constantly disconnecting and stating “owlet camera offline”. I have no peace of mind with this thing. Just buy the cheap $50 plug in camera on Amazon. It’s solid unlike this $300 setup that’s trash.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: I have to close out the app and re open to see new data, it disconnects often despite the sock still showing it’s connected. Too slow for the cost of the sock- not ok.

reviews.title: Nearly Useless App and Even Worse Customer Support
reviews.text:
What’s the point in a $300+ monitoring app when it literally doesn’t work? Good luck getting the camera to work, it randomly goes offline more often than not. Customer Service acts like it’s our fault and will do nothing to help, despite us using a home security system, pet camera and numerous other online devices all day and those virtually have no problems. 

I highly suggest avoiding these products at all costs. Horrible company. Worse products.

reviews.title: App needs faster updates
reviews.text: Hated the owlet sock from newborn to 2 months because it would always go off because he was kicking so much. Now I love the owlet sock and app, it gives me such a peace of mind. However you need to close it out and open it back up to have accurate times. Also I hate that as soon as you take the sock off and you look at the sleep session it counts the whole time wearing it not the actual sleep time. There needs to be more advanced app updates… also baby will be sleeping and it still says awake. Takes time for it to change…

reviews.title: Bugs and Improvement Opportunities
reviews.text:
I have not upgraded to the paying subscription, but maybe I need to address some of these issues.

A major bug that hasn’t been addressed is when the video is switch to Picture in Picture, the video feed goes grey and acts like it’s buffering. Usually I have to go back to the app or quit the app for video to resume.

Also, we lose audio when going to Picture in Picture. It would be a major improvement for the app to keep the audio like other apps do.

We have multiple cameras for different rooms. A new baby profile is required to assign each camera, when I’d rather assign by room and not create new baby profiles since only one camera can be assigned to a baby.

Last, it would be nice to view each camera simultaneously rather than having to switch between cameras. This is helpful for multiple baby households.

reviews.title: Need iPad app
reviews.text: This product is amazing the app less so. I’m pleased the constantly buffering camera when opening the app has gotten better. Still needs some improvement though. And for a product that advertises your device being the monitor and not selling a standalone. Can we get an iPad app? It’s perfect size to have as a sitting monitor while being able to use my phone.

reviews.title: Sucks
reviews.text: Constantly disconnects, waste of time and money

reviews.title: Not reliable
reviews.text: I don’t know what they’ve done with the software but our dream sock is disconnected every night and then going off after “losing connection with sock” then proceeds to go off and wake the baby. We’ve stopped using it.  Think before buying this. More problems than it’s worth.

reviews.title: I’m obsessed
reviews.text: I freaking love the owlet. Idk how I would have gotten through postpartum without it. We have used it every single night since baby was born for 7 months with minimal issue. Thank god for this device

reviews.title: Fix the bugs
reviews.text: From February all the way up til about a month ago, the Owlet was working perfectly. Now, the app SUCKS. Glitches NONSTOP, the updates say they fixed the bugs but in my opinion it just made things worse. I don’t understand how the Owlet went from perfect connection to ALWAYS disconnecting now. Please fix asap.

reviews.title: PiP not working
reviews.text: The Picture in Picture feature has not been working correctly the last couple of weeks. Whenever I do PiP the streaming freezes. I have to force close the app a couple of times to get it to work properly.

reviews.title: Terrible ongoing connection issues
reviews.text: This app is always either buffering or saying the camera is no longer connected. Never works when you need it.

reviews.title: Keeps getting worse
reviews.text: Bugs definitely NOT fixed.

reviews.title: Camera does not work
reviews.text:
In short 3 problems.

1. cameras don’t connect to phone.
2. Can’t have two cameras for one child.
3. Can’t share the camera with wife (only one person per account and camera)

1. + 2 make this unusable



We have bought three of these cameras by now. None of them work properly.

All of them have issue connecting to the the app. This is so annoying when you either need to look or want to go to bed and turn the camera on.

It happens on all our phones.

Also can’t use several cameras with one child.

Can’t use two people, wife and I have to share the app.

Who would have thought that children might have two parents?

reviews.title: Stress you out even more!!!
reviews.text: This is suppose to be ”HELP” you it stress you out even more!!!! Trying to connect it to the WiFi! And once you connect it it disconnects the next day!😡😡

reviews.title: Does the job but..
reviews.text:
I wish you could pick how long you’d like to snooze for. My little one wakes up and I’d still like to see the stats but not turn off monitoring and hate having to hit snooze multiple times. 

Also wish there was a watch app. So I didn’t have to always bring my phone or forget it downstairs in to hit snooze.

reviews.title: App with no notification settings for the sock
reviews.text: The app do not let you modify the sound or type of alerts you receive in phone and station for the sock, this is too noisy for non critical alerts and make me want to stop using it

reviews.title: Do not buy!!!
reviews.text: there costumer service absolutely sucks The dude is literally the rudest person ever. we bought the sock and camera. The sock never worked from day one brushed it off didn’t use it now. The camera doesn’t work hardly a year later they said there’s nothing they can do about it personally I think if you’re producing garbage products and cheap products where they just stopped working then you should probably be ready to help out your customers we spent $445 on stuff that is supposed to help my son stay safe that are absolute garbage a waste of money we bought this brand of thinking that it was a good high-quality absolutely is not now my son has gone almost a month without a baby monitor with absolutely no way for us to check when he’s sleeping at night making us have to bring him in our room and throwing off his entire sleep schedule I cannot stress enough. Do not buy these garbage products.

reviews.title: Just get it
reviews.text: It really is a game changer for my mental health while I’m dealing with postpartum I would not be able to get to sleep that I do. I bought this when my baby was three days old because when I got back from the hospital, I could not sleep. I kept thinking my baby would stop breath. Every night I checked my app and it tells me his stats it has went off numerous times whenever there is a misplacement issue so I know it’s working. I honestly couldn’t live without it.

reviews.title: Buggy and broken
reviews.text: Needs fixed. Only one camera ever loads. Even the most recent update didn’t fix issues. There have been three updates and nothing is fixed. Now neither of my cameras work.

reviews.title: Mid.
reviews.text:
Works, but too many base station connectivity issues. The base is right at the foot of our bed and it plays a loud "CONNECTION ISSUE" sound that wakes the baby. 

"Peace of mind" seems to come at the cost of sleep.

reviews.title: Amazing!!!!
reviews.text: They have a lot of great features. Like the socks base has a mode for when the power goes out that keeps the sock monitoring. It has really given us so much relief while sleeping or eating.

reviews.title: Takes forever to load
reviews.text: Even if I quickly click out and go back in. It just spins and spins and spins. Have to force close the app and reopen.

reviews.title: Super easy and convenient
reviews.text: Super simple to use and I love that I can view the camera from my phone and even talk through it with the click of a button rather than carrying a monitor around everywhere with me

reviews.title: Camera barely works
reviews.text: We have good internet and two owlet cameras.  It seems like when we need them most we can’t view the camera.  We can just see that the room is uncomfortable because our kid is crying to loud.  Extremely annoying for the price.

reviews.title: Saved Me PP
reviews.text: Like most moms, my postpartum anxiety was crippling. This is the only thing that let me sleep those first few months (or a year, who’s keeping track). Highly highly recommend. We never had a false alarm go off, which is the only complaint I’ve heard. But even if we had, I’d rather have 1 or 2 false alarms vs not knowing if something was actually wrong. The socks were easy to clean and were very comfortable on baby’s feet. Thank you for this product, I’d buy over and over again!

reviews.title: Potential is there
reviews.text: We LOVE the sleep sock and if I was just reviewing that I would give 5 stars. However, the baby camera capability with the app is flawed and it often goes out randomly and then I’m not notified when my baby is crying. Multiple times I have woken up to see that the app has been down in the middle of the night (will not self correct unless I close and reopen the app) and my baby had been crying but I was not alerted and couldn’t hear it due to it being down. This breaks my heart and due to this, I will be buying a different monitor to replace this one.

reviews.title: Garbage connectivity
reviews.text: Potentially the worst connectivity between an app and a Base station I think I’ve ever seen. And I’m a software engineer who works on hardware.

reviews.title: The app sucks
reviews.text: I loved the security the owlet sock brings but if your baby is generally healthy you don’t need it. It becomes addictive in a sense. ALSO THE APP SUCKS WITH LOADING!! Most annoying thing trying to check it and spending 10/20 min trying to get it to load when you have no other issues with your wifi! THE CAMERA IS NOT WORTH IT FOR THIS REASON. we had to buy a whole separate camera.

reviews.title: Fail to connect
reviews.text: I’ve had the camera and sock for 6 months. The app is garbage and frequently needs to be forced closed so I can see the camera picture again. We took a trip and brought the camera with us so we could set it up with the baby in the hotel room. It connected fine on the trip, but now that we are home the camera might as well be a paperweight. It says it’s trying to connect but the app can’t find it. We’ve tried resetting the camera, deleting it from the app and even redownloading the app. Nothing works. I can’t believe how expensive this is to not work. I’m going out to buy an old school monitor tomorrow, and selling this to some other schmuck. The sock was cool with the data it collected, but it would frequently give false alarms and wake us up from a dead sleep scared to death! All because the baby wiggled a little in his swaddle. Not worth it! If I could give this zero stars I would.

reviews.title: Cam 2
reviews.text: Not reliable what so ever. The camera almost never loads the first time you open the app. I have notifications for motion, cry, and sound set to high as well as clips recorded when those things are detected. We breathe and it sends a notification, but my daughter climbed out of bed 2 different times and it didn’t notify us. The last recorded clips both times were me leaving her, then running in because she’s fallen and crying at the top of her lungs. The only positive I can give it is when it’s working the camera quality is great. I would not recommend.
